title: Release approval number
subtitle: Find an authorization by its bundle Id and free its approval number, so the pharmacist can submit a new approval with it.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not have access to the Nphies screens. Ask an administrator to grant it.
access.unreachableHint: The access check did not answer. Try again in a moment.

lookup.notFoundHint: No authorization has the bundle Id {{id}}. Check the Id the pharmacist gave you — it must match exactly.
lookup.errorFallback: The authorization could not be read. Try again in a moment.

withheld.dispensed: This authorization is dispensed, so its approval number cannot be released. Undispense it first.
withheld.alreadyReleased: This approval number is already released.
withheld.empty: This authorization has no approval number, so there is nothing to release.
withheld.noGrant: You can see this authorization, but releasing an approval number needs a grant you do not hold.

act.undispenseLink: Open it on the Undispense page
act.dispensedUnknown: This page cannot see whether the authorization is dispensed. If it is, the release will be refused.

dialog.title: Release approval number
dialog.body: Release approval number {{approvalNumber}}? It becomes {{released}}, and the pharmacist can then submit a new approval with the original number. The authorization is not cancelled.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Why is this approval number being released?
dialog.noteRequired: Type a note first — every release is logged with its reason.

refusals.notFound: No authorization has this bundle Id.
refusals.dispensed: This authorization is dispensed. Undispense it first, then release its approval number.
refusals.empty: This authorization has no approval number to release.
refusals.alreadyReleased: This approval number is already released. Nothing was changed.
refusals.noteRequired: A note is required to release an approval number.
refusals.noGrant: You do not hold the grant to release approval numbers. Ask an administrator.

history.title: Release history
history.empty: This approval number has never been released.
history.failed: The release history could not be read.
